Automation: Rules reference · play automation in progress

You spread sudden wings and feel the ground drop beneath your first sweeping beat.

Rules

Action
Maneuver
Attribute
None — no roll
Target / range / shape
Self.
Duration
Instant. Applied conditions follow their normal duration and decay.
Equipment / acquisition
No item needed unless named above.
Limits
Repeatable; pay the action and any stated costs each use.
Type
Magic

Wings carry you up to 4 squares, over creatures and difficult ground, to a visible free supported square. You may cross a gap but cannot pass through barriers. This movement does not provoke; you must land immediately. No hovering or permanent flight.
